lines: Hisame leads you out through a door that wasn't there a moment ago.
Cold air bites at your face. The ruins stretch on ahead, mountains rising pale and merciless beyond them.
"Where are we even going?" you ask.
Hisame doesn't answer. She doesn't even glance back.
"Come on — I should at least know what we're doing," you press.
Hisame stops mid-step. When she turns, her glare could frost the air itself.
"You don't need to know anything," she says. "You do as I say. You don't talk unless I tell you to."
"Your training has started. I won't tolerate any more foolishness from you — next time, I'll punish it."
"Don't forget: you're only alive because of me."
Hisame slows, glancing at you sideways, waiting to see what you'll do with the silence she's given you.

options.label: Are we going to kill someone?

lines: You say nothing and simply fall into step behind her.
Hisame glances back, something almost like approval flickering across her face.
The slap catches you before you finish the sentence, sharp and cold as the air around you.
"I didn't ask for your voice," she says.
She studies you a moment, then scoffs. "Stupid." She turns and keeps walking.
You hold her gaze and say nothing.
"Keep up," Hisame says, not looking back to check that you are.
